traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Love and value meet imagination. Heightened artistic sensibility and romantic idealism. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Refined aesthetic and tender, imaginative affection. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize connection and imagination into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what connection and imagination have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Real artistic gifts; guard against unrealistic expectations of people and outcomes.
shadow: The ease lets indulgence and vanity and illusion and escapism go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.

readerCopy.body: A beautiful idea may receive just enough practical support to become an actual event, collaboration, benefit, or act of care. Venus sextile Neptune can help imagination find a room, budget, contact, or agreement without forcing the idea to lose the feeling that made people care in the first place. Secure the concrete piece while support is available. Confirm the space, cost, schedule, and person responsible for the next step. The vision does not become less meaningful because somebody booked the room and checked the invoice.
